message: Added an OIDC-only mode (BASEROW_OIDC_ONLY) that makes the instance OIDC-only for normal users: self-service signup is disabled, password login is refused for non-staff accounts, and the login page hides the password form and signup and shows only OIDC buttons. A staff/superuser break-glass admin can still reveal the password form and log in if the IdP is unavailable.
